prompt: Four cards show A, K, 4 and 7. Each has a letter on one side and a number on the other. To test 'if a card has a vowel on one side, it has an even number on the other', which cards must you turn?
explanation: Turn A, because a vowel with an odd number would break the rule. Turn 7, because a vowel on its back would also break it. The 4 is irrelevant: the rule says nothing about what must be behind an even number.
